## Goals

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

- Read direction, form and consistency from a scatter plot
- Compute r by hand, and test it
- Say why a correlation doesn't name a cause
- Spot a restricted range and an outlier

## Reading

- {{< fa book >}} Sections 14-1 to 14-4. Skim 14-5: we cover Spearman, point-biserial and phi as ideas, without the calculations.
